title: Teriyaki Earthly Delight Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired stir-fry dish made with earthly delights and savory bean sauce.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add sliced earthly and cook for 3-4 minutes until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together bean sauce, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
Pour the sauce over the earthly and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
Cook for 1 minute until the onions are wilted.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
